    Before you begin

    How this book works

    • ♥Heart a favouriteIt shows on the contents page, and the Favourites filter finds it fast.
    • 🏅Stamp it bakedPress Baked it each time you make a recipe. The page collects dated stamps.
    • ✔Tick as you goTap ingredients and steps to tick them off. Reset clears them for next time.
    • ⏲Built-in timersSteps with a time get a timer button. A chime plays when it is done.
    • 👩‍🍳Cook modeBig, one-step-at-a-time view for the bench, with the screen kept awake.
    • 🛒Shopping listAdd a recipe’s ingredients, tick them off in the shop, copy or download the list.
    • 📷Your bakeFlip the photo to add a picture of your own bake, and jot extra notes.
    • ＋Add a recipeNew approved recipes get their own pages. Save a copy to keep them safe.

    Turn pages with the arrows, your keyboard, the page corners or a swipe. Your hearts, ticks, notes and photos are saved in this browser on this device.

    Recipe 2 · Triple batch

    Mango & Coconut Baked Protein Oats

    Triple batch with lactose-free milk and high-protein yoghurt

    🌡 Oven 180°C⏱ Check from 30 minutes🥣 Triple batch

    Original single-batch baking time: 25 to 30 minutes

    Ingredients

    Mango & Coconut Baked Protein Oats3

    Method

    💗 Your notes

    Doubling the recipe worked well, but triple the quantities for the next batch. Defrosting and draining the mango through a sieve was particularly successful. Use lactose-free milk, Greek-style yoghurt with added protein and honey.

    ✨ Next time

    Try adding ¾ cup chopped macadamias to the triple batch.

    Recipe 3 · Makes 12

    Hashbrown Breakfast Cups

    12 cups, air-fried potato gems

    🧁 Makes 12🍳 12-hole muffin tray🌡 Air fryer 200°C, oven 220°C

    Ingredients

    Hashbrown Breakfast Cups5

    Method

    🧊 Storage

    Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 to 4 days. Reheat thoroughly in the microwave or air fryer.

    💗 Your notes

    Air-frying the potato gems first worked well. Use exactly 5 gems per hole, 8 eggs and 1½ cups of cheese. Keep the peas.

    ✨ Next time

    Add shredded carrot.
